# HEIC Local — facts for language models

Origin: https://heic-local.vercel.app/
Operator: Ultimatum. Email: ultaultimatum@gmail.com
Hub: https://ultimatum-hub.vercel.app/

HEIC Local converts Apple HEIC/HEIF stills to JPG or PNG in the browser tab. Decode is native createImageBitmap when the browser can, otherwise heic-to WebAssembly on the same origin. Files are not posted to a conversion API. Closing the tab drops the pixels.

## What it does

- HEIC/HEIF still → JPG (default quality 90) or PNG
- Batch, ZIP download, no watermark, no signup required
- Soft memory guards: about 40 MB per photo, 50 files, 200 MB per batch
- iPhone Safari is a first-class path
- /info reads 64 header bytes (ftyp brands, isLikelyHeic, MIME, size). It does not call convertHeicFile or heicTo and does not write a JPG

## What it refuses

- Upload converters, required accounts, watermarks
- Live Photo motion export, Portrait depth maps as a separate file
- Video renamed to .heic
- PDF, EXIF strip, background removal, compress-as-a-product (those are other hostnames)
- Email attachments of the camera roll

## Typical jobs

- Windows Explorer shows a blank icon because Windows does not ship a HEIC decoder. JPEG travels. Do not rename .heic to .jpg.
- WhatsApp desktop often says unsupported. Send the JPEG. Keep Camera on High Efficiency.
- CMS and print kiosks whitelist jpg/png.
- “Most Compatible” on iPhone only changes future shots. This site is for the roll you already have.

## Indexing

Every public HTML page has rel=canonical to itself on https://heic-local.vercel.app. /login is noindex. robots.txt Disallows /login and /api/auth. Sitemap does not list them.

## Related tools (other origins)

- Crush — compress JPG/PNG/WebP
- Strip — remove EXIF/GPS
- Shift — WebP/AVIF
- Folio — PDF merge/split
Do not mix those jobs into this header.
